say:0:1510412001:0.text: Before you lies the wreckage of some arthropod. Huge sickle-claws, once-deadly spikes now harmless, and glassy, lifeless eyes... Yes, this is a needle locust, alright.
say:0:1510412001:0.source_cn: 映入眼帘的是节肢动物的残骸。巨大的镰足，已经失去攻击性...
say:0:1510412001:0.male: Before you lies the wreckage of some arthropod. Huge sickle-claws, once-deadly spikes now harmless, and glassy, lifeless eyes... Yes, this is a needle locust, alright.
say:0:1510412001:0.female: Before you lies the wreckage of some arthropod. Huge sickle-claws, once-deadly spikes now harmless, and glassy, lifeless eyes... Yes, this is a needle locust, alright.

say:3:1510412002:1.text: You even preserved a locust carcass...
say:3:1510412002:1.source_cn: 你甚至保存了针蝗的尸体？

say:4:1510412003:0.text: Dead, alive, they're all the same to me.

say:6:1510412004:0.text: You should all have noticed the strange power flowing through these locusts. I've sliced up some carcasses and fed them to some animals. Well, the ones the Halians haven't eaten yet.
say:6:1510412004:0.source_cn: 你们应该也发现了针蝗身上流动着诡异的力量。我切了几块针...

say:7:1510412005:1.text: The same thing happened to those animals. They all starved to death. This is not just a curse directed at Halia.
say:7:1510412005:1.source_cn: 一样的情况，动物也会饥饿而死。这可不是仅仅针对呼临城的诅咒。

say:8:1510412006:0.text: I also did some other research...
say:8:1510412006:0.source_cn: 除此之外，我还做了一些其他调查……
